subject: Private/VPC pricing follow-up — token volumes, licensing, support & env count
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:32:00 -0800
Subject: Private/VPC pricing follow-up — token volumes, licensing, support & env count

Hi Aisha — great to meet today. Quick recap and the info we discussed so you can share with Tom/procurement: 

Call recap:
- Use case: low-latency customer-facing LLM features (KYC, chat, document summarization) behind your VPC.
- Preferred deployment: Private (VPC) with customer-managed networking + dedicated capacity.
- Environments you likely need: prod + staging + one lower env for experiments (you mentioned 2–4).

Open items we promised to follow up on:
1) Token volumes: ballpark monthly ranges and peaks (helps us size reserved capacity and batching).
2) Budget target / unit economics: target $/1M tokens or target monthly spend for procurement.
3) Licensing model preference: term license vs. annual subscription vs. capacity commitment.
4) Support tier: Standard vs. Premium (24/7 + SLA) — any preference?

What we need from you (short):
- Monthly token estimate (low / typical / peak) — e.g., 50M / 120M / 250M.
- Target $ per 1M tokens or target monthly/annual budget range.
- Number of environments to license (prod/staging/test/other).
- Procurement timeline & PO contact (Tom or procurement@fintechco.com).

Next steps from our side:
- Ben will share a concise pricing matrix (platform license + per-environment fees + support tiers + per-token unit economics).
- I'll send a draft SOW and an annotated pricing PDF for your procurement team.

Attaching: Redwood_Private_Pricing_v1.pdf — ballpark matrix (not final).

Would you be able to send the token estimates and preferred support tier by end of day Monday? That will let us produce a formal quote and SOW.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fintechco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@fintechco.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private/VPC pricing follow-up — token volumes, licensing, support & env count

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side after syncing with Tom and procurement: 

Token volumes (monthly, approximate):
- Low: 60M tokens/mo
- Typical: 150M tokens/mo
- Peak: 300M tokens/mo (seasonal spikes, ~10% of time)

Budget / unit economics:
- Budget range we are targeting (total platform + infra): $10k — $35k / month initially.
- For the per-1M-token metric, procurement would like to see target pricing in the ~$8 — $15 / 1M tokens range (they understand licensing/support will affect the final effective $/1M).

Environments:
- 1x prod, 1x staging, 1x dev/test (so 3 environments total). We may add a sandbox later.

Support tier:
- Interested in Premium (SLA-backed, 24/7 on-call) for production.

Procurement timeline & contacts:
- Procurement is aiming to complete vendor selection by EoY (Dec 30).
- Tom Reynolds (cc'd) is the procurement lead and will handle contract/redlines.

Anything else you need from us right now? If you can share a pricing matrix with examples for our typical and peak volumes (incl. dedicated capacity and support line items) that will speed things along.

Thanks,
Aisha
Director of Product, FintechCo
aisha.singh@fintechco.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private/VPC pricing follow-up — token volumes, licensing, support & env count

Hi Aisha — appreciate the quick numbers, that helps a lot. Couple clarifications and a ballpark we can commit to for the EoY procurement window: 

High-level pricing model (ballpark examples for your 150M typical / 300M peak):
- Licensing: one-time setup + annual platform license OR annual subscription. Example ballpark: $120k — $180k / year (depends on term & environment count).
- Environment fee: $2.5k — $5k / environment / month for dedicated VPC instances (prod latency & isolation). For 3 envs, estimate $7.5k — $15k/month.
- Support: Premium SLA add-on ~ $6k — $10k / month (24/7 + SRE on-call).
- Per-token economics: with reserved capacity and KV caching, we can target effective pricing in the range you called out — ~$8 — $12 / 1M tokens for committed volumes. For peak overflow or burst usage we'd apply an overage rate.

Example blended ballpark for typical usage (150M/mo):
- If we price at $10 / 1M tokens -> token cost = $1,500 / month.
- Combined with environment + support + platform split -> total run-rate roughly $15k — $30k / month depending on term and upfront license vs subscription.

We're attaching a concise pricing matrix that shows variants (term license vs subscription, env counts, support tiers) so procurement can see tradeoffs. See Redwood_Private_Pricing_v1.pdf attached.

Next steps:
- I'll update the matrix for the 3-env case and two term options (annual subscription vs 3-year committed license) and drop the SOW draft for your legal/procurement to review.
- If Tom wants, we can set a short call next week to walk procurement through the matrix and SSO/KMS/security items.

On a quick note: could you confirm the desired target dollar-per-1M token we should anchor the quote on (you mentioned $8-$15 range) — if you have a preferred target (e.g., $10 / 1M) that will let us produce the cleanest procurement-friendly quote.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fintechco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private/VPC pricing follow-up — token volumes, licensing, support & env count

Ben / Marissa — thanks, that all looks useful. Procurement would prefer we anchor the initial quote at $10 / 1M tokens (committed), with clear overage terms for bursts. Please produce two quote variants:
- Annual subscription at $10 / 1M tokens (committed) + per-environment fees + Premium support.
- 3-year committed license (upfront) with a lower effective $/1M for committed baseline and documented burst terms.

Tom (cc): procurement is looped — Tom, can you confirm if we should start with the subscription quote or if procurement wants the 3-year option first?

I'll review the attached pricing PDF and return any redlines by Monday EOD. If you can get the updated matrix + draft SOW over by Mon, that would be ideal for us to hit internal signoff before the holidays.

Thanks,
Aisha
